quote: RITUXAN is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with moderate to severe pemphigus vulgaris.
note: Pemphigus vulgaris is the main form of pemphigus; edge is a near parent.

quote: indicated for the treatment of glucocorticoid-induced osteoporosis in men and women receiving glucocorticoids
note: Glucocorticoid-induced osteoporosis is an exact synonym.

quote: Short- term treatment of active duodenal ulcer.
note: Label covers duodenal/gastric ulcers; generic 'Ulceration' spans any organ and is far broader.

quote: indicated as an adjunct to diet and exercise to improve glycemic control in adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus.
note: Directly named.

quote: indicated for the treatment of conjunctivitis and other superficial ocular infections due to susceptible microorganisms
note: Directly named.

quote: fulminating or disseminated pulmonary tuberculosis when used concurrently with appropriate antituberculous chemotherapy, idiopathic eosinophilic pneumonias, symptomatic sarcoidosis.
note: Symptomatic sarcoidosis is listed as an indication.

quote: JOURNAVX is indicated for the treatment of moderate to severe acute pain, including postoperative pain, in adults.
note: Bone pain is a narrower form of the indicated pain; acute-only qualifier makes this weak.

quote: Atrial fibrillation with embolization
note: The treated target is embolization; atrial fibrillation is the setting.

quote: VIBERZI is indicated in adults for the treatment of irritable bowel syndrome with diarrhea (IBS-D).
note: IBS-D is a subtype; edge IBS is a near parent.

quote: TALTZ is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with active non-radiographic axial spondyloarthritis (nr-axSpA)
note: nr-axSpA and ankylosing spondylitis together cover axial spondyloarthritis.

quote: Denosumab-bmwo is indicated for the treatment of hypercalcemia of malignancy refractory to bisphosphonate therapy.
note: Hypercalcemia of malignancy is a form of hypercalcemia; edge is a near parent.

quote: Phenobarbital controls anxiety, decreases muscular activity and lessens nervous excitability in hyperthyroid patients.
note: Sedation of hyperthyroid symptoms, not treatment of hyperthyroidism itself.
Label covers small cell lung cancer only as first-line treatment; recurrent disease is arguably outside that.

quote: indicated for the treatment of relapsing forms of multiple sclerosis (MS)
note: Relapsing MS; edge is near parent.

quote: DUVYZAT is indicated for the treatment of Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD) in patients 6 years of age and older.
note: Directly named.

quote: 1.2 Dermatologic Diseases Bullous dermatitis herpetiformis Contact dermatitis Exfoliative erythroderma Mycosis fungoides
note: Named in list of indicated dermatologic diseases.

quote: indicated for the treatment of pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH) (WHO Group 1) to improve exercise capacity.
note: Label is PAH only; 'hypertensive disorder' is a whole class.

quote: Treatment of adults with moderate to severe plaque psoriasis
note: Plaque psoriasis is a subtype; psoriasis is a near parent (EMA text).

quote: POSLUMA is a radioactive diagnostic agent indicated for positron emission tomography (PET) of prostate-specific membrane antigen (PSMA) positive lesions in men with prostate cancer
note: Diagnostic imaging agent; prostate cancer is not treated.

quote: indicated for the treatment of the signs and symptoms of benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH).
note: Directly named.

quote: indicated for the treatment of mild to moderate acute malaria caused by mefloquine-susceptible strains of P. falciparum
note: Treatment and prophylaxis of malaria.

quote: Prophylaxis of ischemic complications of unstable angina and non-Q-wave myocardial infarction (MI)
note: Intermediate coronary syndrome = unstable angina; preventing its complications is management.
Only systemic JIA is indicated; psoriasis-related JIA is a different subtype and is not mentioned.

quote: ZEVTERA is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with Staphylococcus aureus bloodstream infection (bacteremia) (SAB)
note: S. aureus bacteremia is a S. aureus infection.

quote: to reduce the risk of stroke and systemic embolism in adult patients with nonvalvular atrial fibrillation.
note: Systemic embolism is the prevented outcome.

quote: Community-acquired bacterial pneumonia ( 1.3 )
note: CABP is a subtype of bacterial pneumonia (HAP/VAP excluded).

quote: associated with at least 3 of the following 6 symptoms: restlessness or feeling keyed up or on edge, being easily fatigued, difficulty concentrating or mind going blank, irritability
note: Irritability is only a diagnostic symptom of GAD, which is the indication.

note: E. faecalis is mentioned only as largely resistant.

quote: drug hypersensitivity reactions, perennial or seasonal allergic rhinitis, serum sickness, transfusion reactions.

quote: mild, uncomplicated allergic skin manifestations of urticaria and angioedema

quote: Localized hypertrophic, infiltrated, inflammatory lesions of: lichen planus, psoriatic plaques, granuloma annulare
note: Only specific granulomatous conditions are named; generic 'Granuloma' is overbroad.

quote: Major adverse cardiovascular events (cardiovascular death, nonfatal myocardial infarction and nonfatal stroke) in adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus and established cardiovascular disease (CVD).
note: Established CVD is the population; MACE risk reduction is the target.

note: Hypertension appears only in warnings.

quote: it is indicated for the control of extrapyramidal disorders caused by central nervous system drugs
note: Extrapyramidal disorders are named.

quote: indicated for the treatment of adult patients with relapsed or refractory diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, not otherwise specified (DLBCL, NOS)

quote: Chronic idiopathic constipation (CIC) in adults.
note: Directly named.

note: Rate control is management of atrial fibrillation.

note: Named indication (some labels advise against empiric use).

quote: indicated for the treatment of Social Anxiety Disorder (SAD), also known as social phobia.

quote: Acute gouty arthritis
note: Gouty arthritis is the indicated gout manifestation.
